text:
alexa: quick idea from support tickets: instead of forcing org->project conversion, offer a "soft-split" mode for org keys that attributes usage to both org and projects with configurable weights. helps customers who legitimately share keys across projects but want per-project visibility.

tom: interesting. how would billing work? double-bill? :grimacing:

alexa: not double-bill. billing still charges the org primary bucket, but we emit "attribution weights" so downstream chargeback tooling can allocate cost. console shows both: "Org charged" + "Suggested split".

frank: telemetry needs: add `effective_owner` (org|project), `attribution_weights` (JSON string like `{projA:0.8,projB:0.2}`), and `attribution_mode` (hard|soft|hinted) to access logs. we'll need backfill so finance can test allocations.

tom: storing a JSON string in logs ok? might complicate Prom queries. can we also emit a flattened metric `auth.attribution_proj_<id>` with the weight as a gauge? that'd help dashboards.

alexa: good point. emit both: compact string in logs for audit and per-project gauge metrics for grafana. also add a derived daily job that computes suggested weightings based on last 14d usage.

frank: UX: in the key detail page show a toggle: [Soft-split attribution] with a link to "preview split" that runs the 14d job and shows estimated token allocation per project and suggested weights. include a CSV export for finance.

tom: rollout guardrails: FF for orgs, opt-in via console. default off. canary on internal orgs + two customers. instrument an alert when suggested split would redirect >50% of usage to a single project (maybe they should just convert to a project key).

alexa: SDKs / headers: we'll accept `X-RW-Project` as a hint. if present and mode=hinted, we bias weights towards the hint but still compute using traffic. sample header: ```
X-RW-Project: proj-17
X-RW-Client: js/1.2.3
```

frank: add diagnostic event `auth.attribution_suggestion` when a token's suggested weight for a single project exceeds 90% for 10d — flag as low-risk migration candidate.

ops-bot: ticket INF-1601 created: "auth: soft-split attribution for org keys + telemetry" linked and assigned alexa, tom, frank. due_date in 10d.

alexa: action items: @tom - RFC for metrics + alert rules, @frank - telemetry schema and export format, I'll own console preview + CSV flow. target: RFC + mock CSV by next Wed.

tom: starting RFC now. will include Prom examples for per-proj gauges.

frank: will post schema and sample log line by EOD.
